from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset x to the right half of the screen
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.0
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center = (tl_pos + br_pos) / 2
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "From Secant to Tangent: The Limit Visualized"
        lines = [
            "We start with two points on this parabola.",
            "A secant line connects them for average change.",
            "Watch as we slide the second point closer.",
            "The gap shrinks until it is nearly zero.",
            "The secant transforms into a tangent line."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Create Axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-0.5, 3, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 5, 1],
            x_length=5,
            y_length=5,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": GREY}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "A1", "F6")
        
        # Function: y = 0.5 * x^2 + 0.5
        func = lambda x: 0.5 * (x**2) + 0.5
        graph = axes.plot(func, x_range=[0, 2.8], color=BLUE)
        
        # Points and Secant Logic
        x_p = 0.8
        dx_tracker = ValueTracker(1.5)
        
        def get_secant_line():
            dx = dx_tracker.get_value()
            # Handle the limit case visually
            safe_dx = dx if abs(dx) > 0.001 else 0.001
            x_q = x_p + safe_dx
            
            p1 = axes.c2p(x_p, func(x_p))
            p2 = axes.c2p(x_q, func(x_q))
            
            # Calculate slope and extend the line for better visualization
            slope = (func(x_q) - func(x_p)) / safe_dx
            x_ext_start = x_p - 0.7
            x_ext_end = x_q + 0.7
            
            line_start = axes.c2p(x_ext_start, func(x_p) + slope * (x_ext_start - x_p))
            line_end = axes.c2p(x_ext_end, func(x_p) + slope * (x_ext_end - x_p))
            
            return Line(line_start, line_end, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=3)

        secant_line = always_redraw(get_secant_line)
        
        # Dots
        dot_p = Dot(axes.c2p(x_p, func(x_p)), color=RED)
        dot_q = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(
            axes.c2p(x_p + dx_tracker.get_value(), func(x_p + dx_tracker.get_value())), 
            color=GREEN
        ))
        
        label_p = Text("P", font_size=18).next_to(dot_p, DL, buff=0.1)
        label_q = always_redraw(lambda: Text("Q", font_size=18).next_to(dot_q, UR, buff=0.1))

        # Animation Sequence
        self.play(Write(axes), Create(graph))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_p, label_p))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_q, label_q))
        self.play(Create(secant_line))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Move Q towards P
        self.play(
            dx_tracker.animate.set_value(0.001),
            run_time=6,
            rate_func=slow_into
        )
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Cleanup labels for final view
        self.play(Indicate(secant_line))
        self.wait(1)
